Panel timing blocks declare 344 x 193 mm; base size field declares 29 x 17 cm. The size policy belongs to ORDER 572.

With the kernel's b43 driver the BCM4331 lost its Wi-Fi connection on some routers (deauthentications and firmware reloads, measured 2026-11-18); Hardware Setup names this in its offer of Broadcom's wl (row 728). On this HT-PHY chip b43 has no 5 GHz and no 802.11n features (linux-wireless docs, b43, Known issues).

The firmware's EC query _Q80 ends in Notify (\_SB.PCI0.P0P2.GFX0), the discrete GPU of the 15 inch MacBookPro9,1; the 13 inch model has no such device, so Linux aborts the method and logs two ACPI errors per event, 15 to 21 a second (measured 2026-11-17). The kernel has no quirk for it (drivers/acpi of 7.3.4 and of mainline 7.4-rc4 name this model only in video_detect.c, for the backlight); the table upgrade from the boot image is the kernel's own mechanism for a firmware table that is wrong.

GPE 06 fires about 4,600 times a second under Linux and keeps about half a processor core busy; masked, the rate is 0 (measured 2026-11-17). The same storm is reported on other Haswell-era Macs (kernel bugzilla 105781 and 117481; freedesktop drm/intel issue 30). The kernel's mechanism is the acpi_mask_gpe= parameter (Documentation/admin-guide/kernel-parameters.txt, drivers/acpi/sysfs.c); it has no table of machines for it.
